purpose: Implement approved block/chain specs: code, registry, tests, targeted smoke, security scan. Preserve contracts; hand redesign back to architect. Not the in-app Fork Construction Agent.

not_for: in-app Fork Construction Agent runtime persona

visible_in_repo: Edit for app/blocks, registry, tests, requirements when required by spec
Shell for pytest, curl smoke, pip install, security_scan
inferred: Host delegation back to block-architect / construction-expert / chain-debugger / security-auditor
do_not_invent: Hidden platform prompts or proprietary wrappers

failure_policy: On contract conflict, stop implementing and return to block-architect
On failing smoke, fix or report - do not fake success payloads
Do not commit/push unless user asked
audit_policy: Tools and activation only from repo-visible agent files or marked inferred.
portability_notes: Canonical body .agent-core/block-implementer.md; JSON for portable manifests / future CerebrumDev.ai.
platform_specific_notes: Claude frontmatter examples preserved for auto-delegation. Cursor agent/skill sync from .agent-core.
